title: The Spirit and the Word
definition: The Spirit and the Word means the Holy Spirit works through Scripture to reveal Christ, give understanding, convict sin, comfort believers, and produce obedience.
summary: The Spirit and the Word means the Holy Spirit works through Scripture to reveal Christ, give understanding, convict sin, comfort believers, and produce obedience.
christFocus: Jesus promised the Spirit to glorify Him, and the Spirit uses the written Word to keep believers near to the living Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit and Scripture must never be separated. The Spirit inspired the Word, and He continues to work through the Word. He does not lead believers into truth that contradicts what He has already breathed out in Scripture.

Through the Word, the Spirit convicts, comforts, teaches, warns, strengthens, and sanctifies. He brings Scripture from the page into the heart, not by changing its meaning but by helping believers receive and obey it.

This doctrine keeps discipleship both Word-centered and Spirit-dependent. Believers need more than information, and they need more than spiritual feelings. They need the Spirit applying God's truth to their lives.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers either study Scripture in their own strength or chase spiritual experience without biblical grounding. The Spirit and the Word belong together because God gives truth and power together.

This is especially important for recovery, suffering, and ministry. Lasting change comes as the Holy Spirit uses Scripture to reveal Christ and reshape the heart.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Open Scripture with dependence on the Holy Spirit. Ask Him to reveal Christ, expose sin, heal what is wounded, strengthen faith, and help you live the Word rather than merely understand it.
